# rutter

> A personal memory layer for AI agents. One memory, multiple agents, yours. rutter
> keeps dated records in your own markdown notes folder, each with a content hash
> of the notes it cites. An MCP server for Claude Code, Grok, Codex, Copilot CLI,
> and Antigravity CLI (agy); a personal reference implementation.

## Docs

- [Home](https://ruttermemory.com/): what rutter is, in one page
- [Design](https://ruttermemory.com/design.html): why it is built this way, and what each choice costs
- [Getting started](https://ruttermemory.com/getting-started.html): a setup path for each client (the Claude Code plugin, or npm as rutter-memory), from install to first recall
- [Memory of use](https://ruttermemory.com/memory-of-use.html): capture, recall, enrichment, note identity, positions

## Optional

- [Source hashes](https://ruttermemory.com/sources.json): content hashes of the docs this site was built from
